title: What Have I Normalized?
headline: When Blessings Start to Feel Ordinary
tagline: Many of today’s frustrations were yesterday’s prayers.
seo_title: When Blessings Feel Ordinary: Gratitude vs. Entitlement | TheWrkShop
seo_description: The greatest danger of the heart isn't rebellion; it's familiarity. A devotional for men on gratitude, entitlement and remembering God's faithfulness.
verse_text: The heart is deceitful above all things….

scriptures.text: The heart is deceitful above all things….

items: One of the greatest dangers of the human heart is not rebellion.

blocks.text: What once amazed us…. eventually becomes expected.

items: This is why gratitude slowly disappears.
Led them by a pillar of cloud during the day.
A pillar of fire by night.

blocks.text: Yet before long…. they began complaining about what they didn’t have.

items: One of the ways our hearts deceive us is by convincing us that today’s blessings are ordinary.
Every bit of it is a gift.

blocks.text: Write down five things that were once prayers. Things you now experience regularly. Maybe it’s your marriage, your children, your health, your church, your job, your friendships, your recovery, your growth, your relationship with Jesus.

items: When was the last time I genuinely thanked God for these?

blocks.text: Then ask an even harder question:
Which blessing have I quietly started believing I deserve?
That question reveals where entitlement may be taking root.

items: Spend ten uninterrupted minutes thanking God.
Remember what He rescued you from.
Remember the people He placed in your life.

blocks.text: Because gratitude grows where remembrance lives.

items: And many of today’s ordinary moments….
are miracles we’ve simply grown accustomed to.
